name: @orbb/db
description: Persistence boundary for ORBB (M2-A): Drizzle pg schema + additive migrations for the M0/M1 domain families, domain-shaped repositories with idempotency keys, cursor pagination, the transactional outbox (§4) Db facade, and the append-only access audit (A20). postgres.js driver for Neon Postgres; PGlite in-memory harness for tests.
